name: RaDe-GS Rasterized Depth and Normal Computation
definition: A method to derive rasterized depth and normal maps from 3D Gaussian splats by exploiting the planar property of intersection points in ray space, allowing direct integration into existing Gaussian Splatting pipelines.
summary: RaDe-GS derives rasterized depth and normal maps from 3D Gaussian splats by exploiting ray-space planar intersections, differing from NeRF-based SDF methods.
